newsitem.title: BELGIUM: EU vets BT /News Corp Internet deal.
newsitem.headline: EU vets BT /News Corp Internet deal.

text.p: The European Commission said on Tuesday it was probing a proposed joint venture between British Telecommunications Plc and News International Plc, which belongs to News Corp, to provide services on the Internet.

The joint venture, to be called Springboard Internet Services Ltd, will offer consumer-oriented Internet access and content service in Britain, the Commission said in a notice published in the European Union's Official Journal.
Springboard will also provide consumer-oriented Internet content-only service to EU and worldwide consumers and a third party Web site creation service for business customers, it added.
It said content services would be provide by both Springboard and its parent companies as well as unnamed third parties. Content rights will be acquired both on an exclusive and non-exclusive basis.

The Commission said that the deal apparently fell under EU rules which ban restrictive practices or abuse of dominant position. There is no deadline for it to rule on agreements covered by such rules.
The two partners have stated that BT's technical expertise and News International's "extensive content and editorial skills" are necessary for the joint venture, the notice said.
Interested parties were invited to comment within 10 days.
